_extraction_flags.notes: Excellent FSO-ISAC paper! DCO-OFDM with BCD resource allocation. IEEE IoT Journal 2024. Comprehensive tradeoff optimization framework + ACGN clipping noise model.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Fig.1: System model - LiDAR-based FSO-ISAC with m-QAM→IDFT→DAC→Laser. Sensing for uncooperative targets (backscatter) and comm for cooperative targets. Fig.2: PSD analysis - clipping noise becomes colored (ACGN) with uneven power allocation. Fig.6: Pareto power allocation curves. Fig.7: Spectral efficiency vs sensing precision tradeoff (Pareto frontiers).
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: LiDAR-based FSO-ISAC using DCO-OFDM. Single waveform serves both sensing (ToF estimation) and communication (data to cooperative target). Integration: Joint waveform with power allocation optimization. Clipping noise modeled as ACGN creating equivalent frequency-selective channel.
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Comm: Up to 3.38 bps/Hz spectral efficiency (N=512). Sensing: cm-level precision (2.85-4.4 cm) at 200m range. Configuration: 905nm LiDAR, 102.4 MHz BW, N=128/256/512 subcarriers. log-normal turbulence model. RMSE ~3-8 cm at SNR>2dB. Matches CRB theory.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Contribution: First comprehensive DCO-OFDM analysis for FSO-ISAC with BCD optimization and ACGN clipping noise model. Novel KKT-based closed-form power allocation. Pareto frontier characterization. Gap: Simulation only (no experimental demo), single target scenario, weak turbulence assumption.

bibliographic.title: Free-Space Optical Integrated Sensing and Communication Based on DCO-OFDM: Performance Metrics and Resource Allocation
bibliographic.authors: Yunfeng Wen, Fang Yang, Jian Song, Zhu Han

application.scenario_description: Intelligent Transportation System (ITS) with LiDAR-based FSO-ISAC providing communication to cooperative vehicles and sensing for uncooperative targets.

key_contribution.key_contribution: First DCO-OFDM FSO-ISAC analysis with: (1) ACGN clipping noise model for uneven power allocation, (2) BCD algorithm for joint DC-bias + subcarrier power optimization, (3) Closed-form KKT solutions for Pareto-optimal tradeoff.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Prior FSO-ISAC focused on pulses/single-carrier; no comprehensive multicarrier (OFDM) analysis with clipping noise and resource allocation.

transmitter.notes: 905nm LiDAR. DCO-OFDM: Hermitian symmetry, DC bias b, clipping. N=512 subcarriers, Δf=0.2 MHz, B=102.4 MHz. Total power 1W. Guard interval Tg=2μs for 300m unambiguous range.

receiver.notes: Photodiode with gain G_R=10. Thermal + shot noise modeled as AWGN. Sensing: MLE for ToF. Communication: DFT + equalization.

integration.notes: Single DCO-OFDM waveform. Monostatic sensing (backscatter) + point-to-point comm to cooperative target. Same TX hardware for both functions.

waveform.notes: DCO-OFDM: m-QAM on N/2-1 independent subcarriers. Clipping introduces colored noise (ACGN) in frequency-selective equivalent channel.

channel_wireless.notes: Weak turbulence: Cn2=5e-14 m^-2/3. Atmospheric attenuation -12.8 dB/km. Beam divergence 0.5 mrad. Receiver aperture 10 cm². Hc/Lt=-2.17dB, Hs/Lt=-23.2dB.

comm_metrics.notes: Max spectral efficiency ~3.38 bps/Hz (N=512). Ergodic capacity with 0.05-quantile turbulence attenuation.

sensing_metrics.notes: CRB-based sensing precision. Best achievable: 2.85 cm at N=512. RMSE 3-8 cm at SNR>2dB under various turbulence conditions.

tradeoff.notes: BCD algorithm optimizes DC bias b and subcarrier power P(k). Comm-centric: max C s.t. Fisher ≥ threshold. Sensing-centric: max I s.t. C ≥ threshold. Duality between formulations.
